title: cert-manager CA & TLS Trust: Chiikawa's Bakery HTTPS Lab
description: Chiikawa's bakery goes HTTPS: a CA you generate yourself with openssl, a ClusterIssuer backed by it, a certificate that lights up a waiting Gateway listener -- and the same request failing and then succeeding as trust moves from your laptop to a hand-made ConfigMap to a trust-manager Bundle that keeps every namespace in sync on its own
